{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only converted customers with valid age (not -1)
converted_valid = df[(df['converted'] == 1) & (df['customer_age'] != -1)]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = converted_valid['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Mean age of converters (excluding -1): {mean_age}")"}
